adopt: Point it at a set of units and one change, and watch it stop at the first that does not converge.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
Rolling one change across many services is the part everybody hand-writes and everybody gets wrong the same three ways. Editing config makes the FILE current and never the PROCESS, so a green restart can still serve the old value. A unit that is DOWN reads its file at the next boot, so a change you think you finished reverts one restart at a time, weeks later. And a roll that reached NOTHING is indistinguishable from one that finished, because both exit 0. Measured 2026-08-20 on a 117-unit fleet: the existing roller reported "0 to roll, 54 unmanaged" and returned SUCCESS â€” it could not touch a single service, and said so only in a warning nobody reads.

Install
pip install awroll
